as_of_note: US closes Tue 24 Nov 2026: Nvidia relief rally fades, Dow back above 50k. S&P 500 -0.50% to 7,201.09 (8th loss in 9 days per AP); Nasdaq -1.48% to 23,733.54; Dow +423.39 (+0.85%) to 50,018.70; RUT +0.57% to 2,684.94. Mon 23 Nov had been S&P +4.73%/Nasdaq +6.51% (best since Apr 2025) after Jensen Huang reinstated as NVDA CEO (NVDA +31.5%). Tue: NVDA -5.86%, MU -11.01%, AMD -8.86%, ADI -17.37%, semis index -7.9% (Reuters); XLK -3.26% worst, XLV +2.95% best; ~70% of S&P members up (GS via ZeroHedge). ANT $81.91 (-6.54%), below $83 IPO. WSJ/Reuters: Section 301 'excess capacity' tariffs on 16 partners imminent. VIX 26.36. 10Y 4.91% / 2Y 4.63% (Treasury par). DXY 103.85 (-0.45%). WTI $82.05 (+2.35%), Brent $91.40 (+2.27%) on Hormuz ship attacks. Gold $3,559.90 (-2.45%). Conf. Board confidence 103.3 vs 92.2 est. After hours: DELL +4%, HPQ +9% initially (later reversed per Investing.com), URBN -11%, NTNX -9%.

pce_october_consensus.note: Forecasts: headline ~3.8% y/y (Sep 3.6%); core 3.2% y/y (Sep 3.1%), core m/m 0.3% (some 0.4%). Bowman expects core ~3.3%.

fed_funds_target_range.note: Raised in Sep to 3.75-4.00%, held 28 Oct (10-2, two dissents for a hike). 23 Nov: NY Fed's Williams said inflation 'too high', would 'not exclude' hikes at consecutive meetings; sees inflation ending 2026 at 3.5%. Waller (18 Nov) favours 50bp. No other scheduled Fed speakers this week (Investing.com).

next_fomc.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec 2:00 PM ET = Thu 10 Dec 3:00 AM SGT; SEP meeting. 25bp hike from 3.75-4.00% largely priced. Beige Book Wed 25 Nov 2:00 PM ET = Thu 26 Nov 3:00 AM SGT.

mood.reason: Monday's Huang relief rally faded in tech: Nasdaq -1.48%, semis -7.9%, ANT below IPO; S&P 8th loss in 9 days and still ~7.9% under record. Offsets: breadth was strong (~70% of S&P up, 9/11 sectors green, Dow >50k, RUT +0.57%), yields eased, consumer confidence jumped to 103.3, VIX eased to 26.36. Overhangs: imminent Section 301 tariffs, near-certain Dec hike, PCE Wed.

risks: Data cluster Wed 25 Nov 9:30 PM SGT: Oct PCE (core 0.3% m/m, 3.2% y/y est), Q3 GDP 2nd est, claims (201k est), durables; a 0.4% core could lift odds of Jan/Mar follow-up hikes (investingLive)
Fed: 25bp hike on 10 Dec 3:00 AM SGT largely priced (FedWatch ~90-95%); Williams open to back-to-back hikes; Waller argued 50bp; Beige Book Thu 26 Nov 3:00 AM SGT

Tariffs: USTR Section 301 'excess capacity' findings on 16 partners (incl. China, EU, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore) imminent; caps 15% EU/JP/KR, 20% China if truce (expires 10 Jan) is extended (Reuters)

Nvidia governance/politics: Trump says he'd pardon Huang 'if necessary' and floats US stake; Schumer export-control allegations; Congress 'going to war' with NVDA (POLITICO via @unusual_whales); Huang testimony next week
AI/semis bear-market rally risk: SOXX >42% off June high (Wolfe); MU -11%, AMD -8.9%, ADI -17%; ANT under IPO; neocloud short interest ~$11B (S3 via CNBC)
Geopolitics/oil: renewed vessel attacks near Hormuz, US probing Iran role in tanker cyberattacks; Putin vows response to Ukrainian refinery strikes
Holiday liquidity: NYSE closed Thu 26 Nov; early close 1 PM ET Fri 27 Nov (Sat 2:00 AM SGT)

themes.title: Huang relief rally fades

themes.title: Tariff round two
